subject: Residency SIG: mapping private-connect paths and CAIQ evidence follow-up
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@lumera.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@lumera.com>, security@lumera.com
Date: 2027-08-12T09:11:00Z
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ artifacts + private link mapping for EU pilot

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we scope the pilot for Lumera's EU workstreams we need to finish the vendor SIG and CAIQ checks. Can you provide: 1) the CAIQ responses focusing on data residency and egress controls; 2) an architecture diagram showing how a PrivateLink/privatelink-style connection would appear from our VPC into Redwood's EU boundary; 3) confirmation on where keys are hosted (KMS/HSM) and whether key material for EU tenant data remains in the EU; and 4) a short SOC 2 artifact/summary indicating controls around logging and retention for EU workloads.

Our security team would like the packet by EOD Monday (2027-08-16) if possible. If any items require an NDA or extra paperwork please flag.

Appreciate it,

Asha
Senior Security PM
Lumera Financials

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@lumera.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ artifacts + private link mapping for EU pilot

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a focused packet that addresses each ask. Quick notes and plan: 

- CAIQ: we'll extract the residency/egress-specific answers into a single PDF.
- Private connectivity diagram: Marcus (cc'd on the next message) will produce an annotated Privatelink flow tailored to Lumera's VPC -> EU zone.
- KMS/HSM: we will confirm key residency and include a short diagram and keyflow text file.
- SOC 2: we'll include a one-page assertion summary plus links to SOC 2 artifacts we can share under an NDA if needed.

Naomi — can you start packaging the CAIQ slice and SOC2 summary? Grace — please prepare the privacy/retention bullets for the packet. I'll coordinate delivery and get the Privatelink diagram from infra.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Security Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@lumera.com>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@lumera.com>
Date: 2027-08-13T07:24:00Z
Subject: Privatelink flow and attachments (draft)

Hi all — attaching the draft artifacts for Lumera's review (see attachment stubs below). Key items called out:

1) privatelink-architecture-annotated.png — flow: Lumera VPC (private endpoint) -> Redwood Private Gateway in eu-west-1 -> internal tenant routing (no public internet egress for inference path). Diagram shows egress guardrails and how canary fallback routes to a controlled hosted tier (only on policy).

2) kms-keyflow-eu.txt — text breakdown: master key (CMK) stored in customer-dedicated HSM partition in eu-west; per-tenant data keys are generated and never exported; key rotation cadence and KMS access policy example included.

3) redwood_caIQ_residency_slice.pdf — extracted CAIQ answers focused on data localization, network segregation, and egress minimization.

4) soc2-assertion-summary.pdf — short summary and link to the SOC 2 report access process (requires signed NDA and DPA).

Attachment stubs: [privatelink-architecture-annotated.png (image/png)], [kms-keyflow-eu.txt (text/plain)], [redwood_caIQ_residency_slice.pdf (application/pdf)], [soc2-assertion-summary.pdf (application/pdf)].

Drive: shared secure packet at https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/secure/LUMERA-SIG-PACKET-8342 (expires 2027-09-14).

Notes for audit: the privatelink path keeps inference traffic internal to our EU hosting zone; control-plane telemetry (for usage/ops) is aggregated separately and stored per-region with retention shown in the SOC2 summary. I can add a short trace log sample if Lumera's team wants.

—Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@lumera.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@lumera.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-13T11:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency SIG: mapping private-connect paths and CAIQ evidence follow-up

Asha — attaching the consolidated packet and links (below) so your team can ingest it. To summarize what's included: 

- redwood_caIQ_residency_slice.pdf (CAIQ answers focused on residency, segmentation, egress)
- privatelink-architecture-annotated.png (annotated diagram showing Lumera VPC to Redwood EU zone)
- kms-keyflow-eu.txt (key hosting & rotation notes)
- soc2-assertion-summary.pdf (one-page SOC 2 control summary; full report available under NDA)

Access: https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/secure/LUMERA-SIG-PACKET-8342
Retention/Logging note (short): operational logs for inference requests are retained in-region for 90 days by default; audit logs and request traces are retained 365 days for enterprise contracts and can be configured in Dedicated/Private deployments. We flagged the SOC2 doc with the retention appendix.

If Lumera's security team needs extracts (for example, raw keystore snapshots or a sample request trace) please open JIRA-SEC-2341 and we'll add the artifacts to the secure packet once approvals are in place.

Lauren

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@lumera.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@lumera.com>
Cc: security@lumera.com, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Residency SIG: mapping private-connect paths and CAIQ evidence follow-up

Lauren / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the packet. We've started intake; a couple quick follow-ups from the Lumera controls review: 

- Could you confirm whether tokenization (transient model input caching) is disabled by default in PrivateLink mode? We need assurance that no cached prefixes persist beyond request processing.
- On the KMS note: please confirm whether CMK admin logs are accessible to Lumera via our KMS console or whether we would need a separate audit export.

If you can drop short answers into the ticket (JIRA-SEC-2341) or reply here that'd be great. Otherwise the packet looks good and we'll request the SOC2 access under NDA if needed.

Tom
InfoSec, Lumera Financials
